text_en: Whoever loves discipline loves knowledge, but those who hate to be rebuked are stupid.
text_cn: 喜爱受教的人，必喜爱智慧；憎恨规劝的人，真是糊涂。

text_en: The good obtain favor from the Lord , but those who devise evil he condemns.
text_cn: 善心的人，必得上主喜悦；心术邪恶的人，必受降罚。

text_en: No one finds security by wickedness, but the root of the righteous will never be moved.
text_cn: 没有人作恶而能稳立，唯有义人的根基永不动摇。

text_en: A good wife is the crown of her husband, but she who brings shame is like rottenness in his bones.
text_cn: 贤能的妻子，是她丈夫的冠冕；无耻的妻子，宛如丈夫骨中的腐蚀。

text_en: The thoughts of the righteous are just; the advice of the wicked is treacherous.
text_cn: 义人思念公正，恶人计划诡（guǐ）谲（jué）。

text_en: The words of the wicked are a deadly ambush, but the speech of the upright delivers them.
text_cn: 恶人的言谈，是流血的陷阱；义人的口舌，设法搭救他人。

text_en: The wicked are overthrown and are no more, but the house of the righteous will stand.
text_cn: 恶人一旦倾覆，便不复存在；义人的家室，却得以久存。

text_en: One is commended for good sense, but a perverse mind is despised.
text_cn: 人凭自己的识见，获得赞美；但心地邪僻的人，必受轻视。

text_en: Better to be despised and have a servant, than to be self-important and lack food.
text_cn: 一个自给自足的平民，比爱排场而缺食的人，更为可贵。

text_en: The righteous know the needs of their animals, but the mercy of the wicked is cruel.
text_cn: 义人珍惜禽兽的生命，恶人的心肠残忍刻薄。

text_en: Those who till their land will have plenty of food, but those who follow worthless pursuits have no sense.
text_cn: 自耕其地的人，必得饱食；追求虚幻的人，实属愚昧。

text_en: The wicked covet the proceeds of wickedness, but the root of the righteous bears fruit.
text_cn: 邪恶的想望，是恶人的罗网；义人的根基，却永不动摇。

text_en: The evil are ensnared by the transgression of their lips, but the righteous escape from trouble.
text_cn: 恶人失口，自寻苦恼；义人却能幸免受累。

text_en: From the fruit of the mouth one is filled with good things, and manual labor has its reward.
text_cn: 人必饱尝自己口舌的果实，必按自己的行为获得报应。

text_en: Fools think their own way is right, but the wise listen to advice.
text_cn: 愚昧的人，常以为自己的道路正直；但明智的人，却常听从劝告。

text_en: Fools show their anger at once, but the prudent ignore an insult.
text_cn: 愚昧的人，立时显出自己的愤怒；机智的人，却忍辱而不外露。

text_en: Whoever speaks the truth gives honest evidence, but a false witness speaks deceitfully.
text_cn: 吐露真情，是彰显正义；作假见证，是自欺欺人。

text_en: Rash words are like sword thrusts, but the tongue of the wise brings healing.
text_cn: 出言不慎，有如利刃伤人；智者的口，却常疗愈他人。

text_en: Truthful lips endure forever, but a lying tongue lasts only a moment.
text_cn: 讲实话的唇舌，永垂不朽；说谎话的舌头，瞬息即逝。

text_en: Deceit is in the mind of those who plan evil, but those who counsel peace have joy.
text_cn: 图谋恶事的，心怀欺诈；策划和平的，必得喜乐，

text_en: No harm happens to the righteous, but the wicked are filled with trouble.
text_cn: 义人常无往不利，恶人却备受灾殃。

text_en: Lying lips are an abomination to the Lord , but those who act faithfully are his delight.
text_cn: 欺诈的唇舌，为上主所深恶；行事诚实的，才为他所中悦。

text_en: One who is clever conceals knowledge, but the mind of a fool broadcasts folly.
text_cn: 机智的人，使自己的才学深藏不露；心中愚昧的人，只会彰显自己的愚蠢。

text_en: The hand of the diligent will rule, while the lazy will be put to forced labor.
text_cn: 勤劳的手，必要掌权；懒慢的手，只有服役。

text_en: Anxiety weighs down the human heart, but a good word cheers it up.
text_cn: 忧郁使人心消沉，良言使人心快活。

text_en: The righteous gives good advice to friends, but the way of the wicked leads astray.
text_cn: 义人给自己的友伴指示道路，恶人的行动却引人误入歧途。

text_en: The lazy do not roast their game, but the diligent obtain precious wealth.
text_cn: 懒惰的人，无米为炊；勤劳的人，腰缠万贯。

text_en: In the path of righteousness there is life, in walking its path there is no death.
text_cn: 正义的路，导向生命；邪恶的路，引人丧亡。
